name: Floppy Bunko 24 - Sadistic Gamers Syndrome - Episode 2
original_name: フロッピー文庫24 サディスティックゲーマーズシンドローム エピソード２
source:
You play as a student who is having trouble with his studies. Lucky for you, your teacher is willing to give you a supplemental lesson. If you’re smart enough, this lesson can turn into sex.

[From [url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/pc88/766498-sadistic-gamers-part-2-otanjoubi-play/reviews/157489]TheSAMMIES review]
translation:
玩家扮演一名學習遇到困難的學生。幸運的是，老師願意幫你補習。只要你足夠聰明，這堂課就可能變成性關係。

[來源：[url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/pc88/766498-sadistic-gamers-part-2-otanjoubi-play/reviews/157489]TheSAMMIES評論[/url]]
